source_note: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求
english_source_note: Difference Conditions for Uniform Distribution mod 1
callout_id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#1
english_title: Proposition 1: A Necessary Condition for Uniform Distribution Modulo 1
statement_en:
If the sequence $x_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$, then its difference sequence $\Delta x_n$ must satisfy
$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} n|\Delta x_n|=+\infty.$$
callout_body: 如果序列$x_n$是模1均匀分布的，那么序列的差分$\Delta x_n$需要满足条件$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} n|\Delta x_n|=+\infty$$
